## What is still open
- Priya needs you to restore widget CSV export in dashboards v2 using the new background export flow. It’s a blocker for enabling `dashboards_v2` for Orbitly on Thursday, Nov 19; staging is due to be ready today. [10][3]
- In PR #427, your Orbitly staging check confirmed all nine dashboards load, but hovering over an empty retention cohort crashes the tooltip. The fix is still pending and tracked in #432. [1][8]
- Rachel is waiting for an ETA she can give Zest Grocers before Monday’s ops review. Your background CSV export fix for #424 streams large exports and emails a signed link; Daniel approved PR #430, with merge pending green CI. [9][6][2][5]

## What changed
- Maya backed shipping v2 behind the flag and keeping ChartKit until v1 is retired. Dependabot separately proposed a ChartKit 5 upgrade in #429 that changes the tooltip API and drops legacy browser support. [7][4]
